assumptions: Sun position from astral, the code brainSOL's sun mode uses. Weather is hourly Open-Meteo history, read linearly between hours, so clouds shorter than an hour do not show.
Forecasts are the Open-Meteo forecast issued one day before, so a planner sees realistic forecast errors.
Panel light and power follow the brainSOL simulation model: 1 W/m² counts as 110 lx, diffuse light counts the same at every panel angle, no heat or wiring losses.

The crop stands under an array with the given ground coverage ratio. Panels intercept direct light by their projected area and hide that share of the sky, crop light is ground average, no row geometry or reflection.

Light becomes PPFD at 2.02 µmol/m²/s per W/m². Stress is light above the recipe's max_ppfd, or a leaf warmer than tmax_c, the leaf taken as air temperature plus 3 °C per 1000 µmol/m²/s (no wind or humidity).
Turning away moves the panel normal from the sun towards the zenith and over the top, so power falls with cos(offset) until a servo limit is reached.

Electricity is sold at the bidding zone's day-ahead price (Energy-Charts, from SMARD/ENTSO-E), with no fees, grid charges or feed-in tariff, unless --flat-price sets one. The kit panel is scaled to one m² of ground by the ground coverage ratio.

Crop value: each mol/m² of light up to the daily target grows yield_g_mol of fresh harvest, every stressed hour costs 5 % of the day's growth. It sells at the day's price from the Kaggle vegetable price table (Indian wholesale markets, agmarknet.gov.in, 2023), converted at inr_per_eur and matched by calendar day, so the crop prices are Indian wholesale levels, well below Austrian ones. yield_g_mol in recipes.json is a rough typical value, replace it with your own.

steps.csv.description: One row per time step: sun, weather, forecast, and the tracker in sun mode (offset 0).

time_local.description: the same moment in the site's time zone

date_local.description: local day the step belongs to, days and DLI are counted by it

sun_az.description: sun azimuth on the compass, north 0, east 90

sun_rel_az.description: sun azimuth seen from the device, clockwise from its front

ghi_wm2.description: global horizontal irradiance, dni * sin(el) + dhi

fc_temp_c.description: day-ahead forecast of temp_c, empty without forecast

price_eur_mwh.description: day-ahead electricity price of the bidding zone, known the day before, can be below 0

pan.description: pan of the tracker in sun mode

tilt.description: tilt of the tracker in sun mode, 90 is flat

incidence_deg.description: angle between panel normal and sun, empty at night

panel_lux.description: light on the panel plane, what the BH1750 on the panel reads

power_wm2.description: power_mw scaled to one m² of ground under the array, see wm2_per_mw

fixed_mw.description: power of the same panel parked flat, the no-tracking baseline

ppfd.description: light reaching the crop under the array in sun mode

fixed_ppfd.description: light reaching the crop under flat panels

open_ppfd.description: light on open ground without panels

plant_lux.description: ppfd as the plant light sensor reads it

leaf_temp_c.description: estimated leaf temperature in sun mode, air plus 3 °C per 1000 µmol/m²/s

plant_lux_meas.description: plant_lux with the same sensor noise

alternatives.csv.description: Every action at every step: what turning the panel offset_deg away from the sun gives. The action table for learning the power and light trade-off and for RL.

offset_deg.description: how far the panel turns away from the sun, 0 is sun mode, 90 edge on

pan.description: pan of that pose, inside the servo limits

incidence_deg.description: angle between panel normal and sun

ppfd_direct.description: the direct sun part of ppfd

plans.csv.description: The best plans per recipe, made with the day's weather and prices known in advance, one action per plan_min: the bar a planner is compared with. objective target meets the light target with the most energy, objective profit earns the most money.

stress.description: the crop is stressed in this step

power_hour.description: the recipe puts power first in this step

days.csv.description: Per local day, recipe and strategy: what the report says. tracking is sun mode, offset_N holds one offset all day, flat parks the panel, oracle is the best plan for the light target, profit the best plan for money. Money is per m² of ground under the array.

strategy.description: tracking, offset_N, flat, oracle or profit

energy_pct.description: of the most energy the day could give

dli.description: daily light integral at the crop

score.description: energy share - dli_weight * missing share of the light target - stress_weight * stress_h, weights in scoring, higher is better, the RL reward sums to it

elec_eur.description: electricity sold at the day-ahead price

crop_kg.description: fresh harvest grown that day: yield_g_mol per mol up to the target, less stress losses

crop_price_eur_kg.description: the day's market price of the recipe's crop from the vegetable price table

profit_eur.description: elec_eur + crop_eur, revenue before costs, the RL profit reward sums to it
